description: Schedule a finished static Picorn file (one image, or several slides as one carousel), or an existing video from picorn_posts_upload_video, on the user's connected social accounts for the given platforms. Static MCP files are re-rendered; uploaded videos publish the original bytes without rendering. scheduledAt is ISO-8601 with timezone (e.g. 2026-11-02T09:00:00+01:00); publishNow: true posts immediately. Calling it again for the same file reschedules the existing post. Each post costs $0.02 from the Picorn balance. With several accounts on one platform pass accountIds (from picorn_account_status); otherwise the first connected account per platform posts. The file must belong to the user: created while connected with the token, or listed by picorn_files_list. Requires a Picorn access token.

accountIds.description: Exact accountIds from picorn_account_status. Each must be on one of the platforms.

platformConfigurations.description: Post for Me platform_configurations keyed by platform, e.g. { "instagram": { "placement": "timeline" } }.
